subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) She had to work very hard in the kitchen. (b) That is why, she was called Cinderella. (c) She had two elder sisters. (d) Her mother was dead. (e) Sometimes, to keep warm, she crept among the cinders. (f) Once upon a time there lived a maiden named Cinderella. (g) Her sister were unkind to Cinderella. (h) They made her stay among the pots and kettles and do all the hard work about the house.
guide_solution: f → d → c → g → h → a → e → b
